summary: A play has a name, hosts, optional become (privilege escalation via sudo, su, pfexec, doas, pbrun, dzdo or ksu) and tasks; the example uses ansible.controller.project and ansible.controller.job_template to create a project and job template.
questions: What are the parts of an Ansible play?
How do I enable privilege escalation in a play?
How do I create a controller project and job template from a playbook?
